title: PAR-20/7G.3 DWG GROUP dictionary ownership writer slice
mode: Local generated implementation and focused validation; uncommitted
scope: Move GROUP dictionary entries from the physical NOD to the nested ACAD_GROUP dictionary using a registration path distinct from generic NOD children.
Require one registered GROUP frame with matching dictionary key, handle, owner, and emitted member entities; remove the DWG direct-NOD name fallback.
Separate the DWG GROUP TV name from DXF group-300 description storage and validate generated zero/one GROUP graphs across supported writer versions.

implementation.writerPath: Added registerDwgGroupDictionaryEntry through dwgRW and dwgWriter; dwgWriter15 stages normalized unique (key, handle) pairs, emits them in the ACAD_GROUP DICTIONARY, retains dictionary/frame receipts through compound transaction rollback, and validates exact frame cardinality before completing the file.
implementation.groupFrame: writeGroup now requires a registered exact name/handle, ACAD_GROUP parent, unique frame, unique member handles, and every member to already exist in the model/paper/user-block emitted entity lists. Failed GROUP writes latch whole-file failure.
implementation.payloadFields: DRW_Group::parseDwg and encodeDwg use the inherited name for the DWG TV group name; m_description remains the DXF group-300 description field.
implementation.adapter: resolveGroupNames no longer accepts direct-NOD aliases; it requires the nested dictionary and exact dictionary/group owner handles, then checks the DWG TV name against the dictionary key without overwriting it. DXF parsing resolves the name from the dictionary while retaining description separately.
implementation.generatedCoverage: Added a focused selector and CTest. Zero/one GROUP cases are generated for AC1015, AC1018, AC1021, AC1024, AC1027, and AC1032. AC1024 negatives cover direct-NOD alias registration in both orders, case-folded duplicate keys, unregistered GROUP frame, registered entry without frame, duplicate frame emission, wrong parent, and missing member. The positive case uses two ordered entities, distinct GROUP name/description values, flags, and a following XRECORD sentinel.

assessment.remainingBoundary: External producer variants, LibreCAD/LibreCAD_3 runtime integration, native CAD acceptance, root-entry reciprocity/layout graph work, and broader 3D semantics remain unqualified/open.

tests.result: PASS (1/1; six-version positive matrix and AC1024 negative controls)
